Hi Elena / AP team —

Thanks for agreeing to move ahead with Redwood. I'm kicking off the procurement onboarding for FluxForge so we can get POs and first payments set up. To keep this tight, can you please return the items below by EOD next Thursday (2026-11-25):

Required docs / actions (quick checklist)
- Completed vendor intake spreadsheet (attached: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx) 
- Tax form: W-9 (US entity) OR W-8BEN-E (non-US entity) — please sign and return scanned PDF
- VAT registration certificate if FluxForge is VAT-registered in EU (pdf)
- Bank details (SWIFT/IBAN) + beneficiary name matching legal entity on the tax form
- Point of contact for billing and remittance (name + email + phone)

Notes on PO and timing
- Once we receive the intake form and tax doc, Procurement will create a PO.
- Standard lead time for PO issuance is 3–5 business days after approvals.
- First invoice should reference Redwood PO number; we will confirm PO number in the PO email.

If any of these items need DocuSign, say so and I’ll route it. I’ve cc'd Marissa from Finance to help with bank verification.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx (please populate and return), sample vendor checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

2) Is there a fiscal name / entity ID field we need to match exactly on the intake spreadsheet?

We aim to return everything by Wednesday 2026-11-18. If we hit any snags, I’ll loop in our legal/finance.

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and the corporate info.

Answers:
- W-8BEN-E: a signed PDF is sufficient for Redwood procurement. Notarization is not required unless your bank requests it for their AML procedures.
- Intake spreadsheet: please make sure the "Legal entity name" and the tax/registration number match exactly what is on the W-8BEN-E and VAT cert. That speeds bank verification.

Next steps I will action on my side:
- Marissa will validate the bank details once you send them (we may ask for a bank letter if the beneficiary name differs).
- Vivek (legal) is on copy to confirm we don’t need additional corporate attestations.
- I’ll open the PO request in Procurement as soon as we have: completed intake spreadsheet + signed W-8BEN-E + VAT cert + bank details.

If it's helpful, I can send a DocuSign envelope for the W-8BEN-E to make signature capture easier — let me know.

Thanks — appreciate the turnaround.

Jonas
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
